scope: Construction test requirements only. No compiler fixtures or execution success are claimed by this file.

runner_contract.expected_reject: match registered stage and reason; generic process failure is not acceptance
runner_contract.output: Create a fresh RunId directory; write result.json, command/input/source/profile/toolchain hashes, stdout/stderr, exit code, selected/executed/assertion counts and per-case results. Never overwrite evidence.

process_exit.meaning: Compare the real main process exit status on the selected target; do not use this field for arbitrary typed function results.

entry_return.meaning: The native test harness calls the named typed function and records its complete typed result. Values above 255 must not be truncated to shell exit status; compile and run the ordinary ZIL function, never substitute constant parsing.

observable_contracts.separation: The manifest chooses the observable. Never infer process status from return_value or return_value from process status.
